summary: Innventure, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026 disclosing that senior management and directors forfeited an aggregate 435,168 shares of common stock tied to Milestone One, an Accelsius purchase order from Dark NX, following a Board decision announced in an August 18, 2026 shareholder letter. Seven named insiders, including Michael Otworth, signed forfeiture agreements dated August 24, 2026, and the transfer agent canceled the shares between September 8 and September 15, 2026. The forfeiture unwinds previously issued earnout compensation rather than a market transaction, eliminating insider overhang tied to the milestone. Watch for further earnout-milestone disclosure, board or management follow-through, and any governance or litigation risk around the original awards.
